settings.title: Where you can find us
settings.body: RYVT is active on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook. Those are the only accounts we run. Any other profile using our name, marks or imagery is not us — report it and let us know.

settings.title: Our posts are not advice
settings.body: Content we publish about training, fit or fabric care is general information shared in good faith. It is not medical, fitness or professional advice. Speak to a qualified professional before starting or changing a training programme.

settings.title: Product representation
settings.body: We photograph our garments as honestly as we can. Colour reproduces differently on every screen, and garment-dyed fabric varies slightly batch to batch — that is a feature of the process, not a fault. The product page carries the authoritative description, composition and measurements; a social post never overrides it.

settings.title: Offers posted socially
settings.body: Promotions announced on social media run on the terms stated in that post and are subject to our Terms & Conditions. Where the two differ, the Terms govern. We may end a promotion early if stock runs out.

settings.title: Comments and community
settings.body: We welcome honest opinion, including criticism. We will hide or remove comments that are abusive, discriminatory, spam, or that share someone's private information. Repeat offenders get blocked. Removing a comment is a moderation decision, not a comment on its truth.

settings.title: Your content and tags
settings.body: Tagging us or using our hashtag may lead us to ask about resharing your photo. We always ask first and we always credit. We never use your image in paid advertising without separate written permission. If you want a reshare taken down, message us and it goes.

settings.title: Ambassadors and gifting
settings.body: Where we gift product or pay for a post, we require the creator to disclose it clearly in line with FTC guidance. If you see one of our collaborations that is not properly disclosed, tell us — we will fix it.

settings.title: Third-party platforms
settings.body: Instagram, TikTok and Facebook are run by their own companies under their own privacy policies and terms. We do not control how they handle your data. Links we post to other sites are not endorsements of everything on them.

settings.title: Support requests
settings.body: We read direct messages but they are not a support channel — order issues get lost there. For anything about an order, use the contact page so it reaches the right person with your order number attached. Never send payment details over social media.
